final_pass_rule: Final PASS requires every required behavior probe to pass against the generated artifact.
preview_requirement: Openable HTML artifact is required before behavior can be evaluated.

probe_targets.acceptance_criterion: Tracker UI records or changes a visible item/count/completion state.
probe_targets.expected_observation: A count, selected state, streak, or tracked item changes visibly.
observable_actions: add, toggle, increment, or select a tracker item

prompt: make a simple habit streak tracker
